name: PM-KISAN
short_description: Provides financial support to eligible landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Eligible farmer families meeting the scheme requirements.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000.
how_to_apply: Register through the official PM-KISAN system or use an authorised service centre.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
short_description: Crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against losses from specified natural calamities, pests and diseases.
who_is_it_for: Eligible farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
eligibility: Farmers meeting the scheme and notified-area/crop requirements.
benefits: Crop insurance protection against covered crop losses.
how_to_apply: Apply through the official crop insurance system, participating banks or authorised channels.

name: Kisan Credit Card
short_description: Provides farmers with timely credit support for cultivation and other eligible agricultural needs.
eligibility: Farmers meeting the lending institution and scheme requirements.
benefits: Access to agricultural credit through a simplified credit mechanism.
how_to_apply: Apply through participating banks or eligible financial institutions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
short_description: National financial-inclusion programme aimed at providing access to basic banking services.
who_is_it_for: Individuals who need access to basic banking and financial services
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the banking account-opening requirements.
benefits: Access to basic banking and financial services.
documents_required: Other documents required by the bank
how_to_apply: Approach a participating bank or authorised banking channel.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
short_description: Renewable life insurance scheme for eligible bank account holders.
who_is_it_for: Eligible bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years
eligibility: Individuals aged 18–50 with an eligible savings bank account.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance coverage, subject to scheme terms.
how_to_apply: Enrol through the participating bank or eligible financial institution.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
short_description: Accident insurance scheme for eligible savings bank account holders.
who_is_it_for: Eligible bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years
eligibility: Individuals aged 18–70 with an eligible savings bank account.
benefits: ₹2 lakh coverage for accidental death and total disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability, subject to scheme terms.
how_to_apply: Enrol through the participating bank or eligible financial institution.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
short_description: Provides institutional credit support for eligible micro and small business activities.
who_is_it_for: Eligible micro and small business entrepreneurs
eligibility: Applicants must meet the lending institution and scheme requirements.
benefits: Access to eligible business loans through participating lending institutions.
how_to_apply: Apply through participating banks, NBFCs or other authorised lending institutions.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
short_description: Provides support to eligible street vendors to help strengthen their working capital and livelihood.
eligibility: Street vendors meeting the scheme's eligibility and verification requirements.
benefits: Access to eligible working-capital support through the scheme.
how_to_apply: Apply through the official PM SVANidhi system or authorised channels.

name: Stand-Up India
short_description: Supports entrepreneurship among eligible SC, ST and women entrepreneurs starting Greenfield enterprises.
who_is_it_for: Eligible SC, ST and women entrepreneurs
eligibility: Eligible SC/ST or women entrepreneurs meeting the scheme and lending requirements.
benefits: Access to institutional credit support for eligible Greenfield enterprises.
how_to_apply: Apply through participating banks or the official Stand-Up India system.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
short_description: Scholarship support for eligible students to encourage continuation of studies after Class VIII.
eligibility: Students meeting the scheme's academic and family-income requirements.
benefits: Financial scholarship support for eligible students.
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal or the designated state process.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
short_description: Scholarship support for meritorious students pursuing higher education.
eligibility: Students meeting the academic, income and other scheme conditions.
benefits: Financial scholarship assistance for higher education.
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

name: PM-Vidyalaxmi
short_description: Education-financing support for eligible students pursuing higher education.
who_is_it_for: Eligible students admitted to covered higher education institutions
eligibility: Students meeting the scheme's institution and other eligibility requirements.
benefits: Facilitates education loans and related financial support.
how_to_apply: Apply through the official education-loan/application platform.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
short_description: Government health assurance scheme providing eligible beneficiaries access to covered hospitalisation services.
eligibility: Eligibility is determined according to government beneficiary criteria.
benefits: Health coverage for eligible hospitalisation services under scheme rules.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility and access services through an authorised Ayushman Bharat channel.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
short_description: Makes quality generic medicines available through dedicated Janaushadhi outlets.
eligibility: Citizens can purchase eligible medicines from participating outlets.
benefits: Access to affordable generic medicines.
how_to_apply: Visit a participating Janaushadhi Kendra with a valid prescription where required.
official_source: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
short_description: Nutritional support for notified tuberculosis patients under the national TB programme.
who_is_it_for: Eligible tuberculosis patients registered under the programme
eligibility: TB patients registered in the government TB notification system.
benefits: Nutritional support subject to the scheme's applicable rules.
how_to_apply: Registration is generally carried out through the government TB programme and Nikshay system.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
short_description: Housing support for eligible urban families under the government's affordable housing programme.
eligibility: Households meeting the applicable PMAY-U 2.0 eligibility conditions.
benefits: Housing assistance through applicable components of the scheme.
documents_required: Other documents required by the applicable component
how_to_apply: Apply through the official PMAY-Urban system or designated local authority.
official_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
short_description: Financial assistance for eligible rural households to construct or improve a dwelling.
eligibility: Eligibility is determined according to the rural housing scheme criteria.
benefits: Financial assistance for eligible rural housing.
how_to_apply: Eligible beneficiaries are identified and processed through the rural housing programme and local authorities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
short_description: Supports eligible households in accessing LPG connections.
who_is_it_for: Eligible households, particularly those meeting the scheme's deprivation and household criteria.
eligibility: Applicants must satisfy the applicable PMUY eligibility requirements.
benefits: Support for obtaining an LPG connection under the scheme.
how_to_apply: Apply through an LPG distributor or the official PMUY process.
official_source: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Free Legal Services through NALSA
short_description: Provides free legal services to eligible persons through the legal services authorities system.
who_is_it_for: Persons eligible for free legal services under applicable law.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on categories and conditions specified under the Legal Services Authorities Act.
benefits: Access to eligible free legal advice and representation.
documents_required: Documents related to the legal matter
how_to_apply: Approach the appropriate Legal Services Authority or use the official NALSA platform.

name: Victim Compensation Scheme
short_description: Provides compensation support to eligible victims of crime under applicable victim compensation provisions.
eligibility: Eligibility and compensation depend on applicable law and the relevant State/UT scheme.
benefits: Financial compensation subject to applicable rules.
documents_required: Medical or other supporting records where applicable
how_to_apply: Apply through the relevant Legal Services Authority or designated authority.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
short_description: Government portal for reporting cybercrime complaints.
eligibility: Anyone needing to report a cybercrime can use the appropriate reporting facility.
benefits: Online channel for reporting cybercrime to the authorities.
documents_required: Evidence such as screenshots or transaction records where available
how_to_apply: Submit a complaint through the official cybercrime reporting portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyaan
short_description: Digital literacy programme aimed at enabling eligible rural citizens to use digital devices and services.
eligibility: Eligibility is based on the programme's beneficiary conditions.
benefits: Digital literacy and training support.
how_to_apply: Register through an authorised PMGDISHA training centre.

name: Digital India Programme
short_description: Government programme focused on expanding digital infrastructure, services and digital empowerment.
eligibility: Specific services and initiatives under Digital India have their own eligibility conditions.
benefits: Access to digital government services and digital infrastructure initiatives.
how_to_apply: Use the relevant Digital India service or programme.

name: IndiaAI Mission
short_description: Government mission supporting development and adoption of artificial intelligence capabilities in India.
who_is_it_for: Eligible researchers, startups, institutions and other participating stakeholders depending on the initiative.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by IndiaAI initiative or programme.
benefits: Opportunities and support under applicable IndiaAI initiatives.
how_to_apply: Apply through the relevant IndiaAI programme or call.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
short_description: Pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers.
eligibility: Generally targeted at eligible unorganised workers within the scheme's age and income conditions.
benefits: Pension support after meeting the scheme's contribution requirements.
how_to_apply: Enrol through an authorised Common Service Centre or official channel.

name: National Social Assistance Programme
short_description: Social assistance programme providing support to eligible vulnerable persons and households.
who_is_it_for: Eligible elderly persons, widows, persons with disabilities and other covered beneficiaries.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable NSAP component and government criteria.
benefits: Social assistance under applicable programme components.
how_to_apply: Apply through the relevant State/UT/local government process.

name: SMILE - Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise
short_description: Umbrella scheme supporting rehabilitation, welfare, skills and livelihood opportunities for covered marginalised groups.
who_is_it_for: Covered marginalised individuals including persons engaged in begging and transgender persons under applicable components.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable SMILE sub-scheme.
benefits: Rehabilitation, medical, counselling, education, skill development and livelihood support under applicable components.
how_to_apply: Access through the applicable implementing authority or designated channel.
official_source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Khelo India
short_description: National programme supporting sports development and sporting talent.
who_is_it_for: Eligible athletes, youth and sporting institutions under applicable components.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by Khelo India component or opportunity.
benefits: Sports training, development and support opportunities under applicable programmes.
how_to_apply: Participate through the relevant Khelo India programme or selection process.

name: National Sports Development Fund
short_description: Government-supported fund for promoting and supporting sports development.
who_is_it_for: Eligible sportspersons and sports-related initiatives under applicable support mechanisms.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable funding or support mechanism.
benefits: Financial or developmental support for eligible sports initiatives and talent.
how_to_apply: Apply through the relevant sports authority or programme.

name: Scheme of Scholarship and Fellowship for Promotion of Art and Culture
short_description: Support for eligible artists and cultural practitioners under government cultural programmes.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by the applicable scholarship or fellowship component.
benefits: Financial support for eligible cultural and artistic work.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Ministry of Culture's applicable programme.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
short_description: Rural roads programme aimed at providing all-weather road connectivity to eligible rural habitations.
eligibility: Coverage is determined through the programme's rural connectivity criteria.
benefits: Improved rural road connectivity and access.
how_to_apply: Roads are developed through government planning and implementation rather than individual household applications.

name: PM E-DRIVE Scheme
short_description: Government scheme supporting adoption of electric mobility and related infrastructure.
who_is_it_for: Eligible electric vehicle buyers and other covered stakeholders.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on vehicle type and scheme conditions.
benefits: Applicable incentives and support for eligible electric mobility.
how_to_apply: Benefits are accessed through eligible vehicles and participating channels under scheme rules.

name: Bharatmala Pariyojana
short_description: National highways development programme focused on improving road connectivity and transport efficiency.
who_is_it_for: Citizens, businesses and communities benefiting from improved highway infrastructure.
eligibility: Infrastructure programme; there is generally no individual beneficiary application.
benefits: Improved highway connectivity and transport infrastructure.
how_to_apply: Infrastructure is planned and implemented by government agencies.

name: PRASHAD - Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive
short_description: Develops pilgrimage and heritage destinations to improve tourism infrastructure and visitor facilities.
who_is_it_for: Pilgrims, tourists and communities at covered destinations.
eligibility: Destination-development programme; individuals generally do not apply directly.
benefits: Improved tourism infrastructure and visitor facilities.
how_to_apply: No individual application is generally required.

name: Swadesh Darshan
short_description: Government tourism programme supporting development of sustainable and thematic tourism destinations.
who_is_it_for: Tourists and communities at covered destinations.
eligibility: Destination-development programme rather than an individual-beneficiary scheme.
benefits: Improved tourism infrastructure and destination experiences.
how_to_apply: No individual application is generally required.

name: Incredible India
short_description: National tourism initiative promoting travel destinations and tourism experiences in India.
eligibility: Open tourism information initiative.
benefits: Access to official tourism information and destination resources.
how_to_apply: Use the official tourism information portal.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
short_description: Programme focused on providing functional tap-water connections to rural households.
eligibility: Coverage is implemented through rural water-supply planning and State/UT programmes.
benefits: Access to household tap-water supply under the programme.
how_to_apply: Implementation is generally through local government and State/UT water-supply systems.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission
short_description: National sanitation programme supporting cleanliness, sanitation and waste-management improvements.
eligibility: Specific benefits depend on the applicable rural or urban component.
benefits: Sanitation infrastructure and cleanliness support under applicable programmes.
how_to_apply: Use the relevant State/UT or local-government sanitation programme.

name: Ujjwala 2.0
short_description: Provides LPG connection support to eligible households under the Ujjwala programme.
eligibility: Applicants must satisfy the applicable Ujjwala 2.0 eligibility requirements.
benefits: Support for obtaining an LPG connection.
how_to_apply: Apply through an LPG distributor or official Ujjwala channel.
official_source: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
short_description: Government initiative promoting the value, protection and education of the girl child.
eligibility: Programme activities depend on the applicable government initiative and local implementation.
benefits: Support for awareness, education and empowerment of girls.
how_to_apply: Participate through applicable government programmes and local initiatives.
official_source: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
short_description: Maternity benefit programme providing financial support to eligible pregnant and lactating women.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable PMMVY conditions.
benefits: Maternity benefit assistance subject to scheme rules.
documents_required: Other documents required under the scheme
how_to_apply: Apply through the designated PMMVY system or local implementing authorities.
official_source: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Mission Shakti
short_description: Umbrella programme focused on women's safety, security and empowerment.
who_is_it_for: Women and girls covered by applicable components.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the specific Mission Shakti component.
benefits: Access to safety, support, empowerment and related services.
documents_required: Other documents depending on the service
how_to_apply: Access the relevant Mission Shakti service through designated government channels.
official_source: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
short_description: Provides skill training and certification opportunities to eligible candidates.
who_is_it_for: Eligible youth and other candidates seeking skill development
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable PMKVY training component.
benefits: Skill training, assessment and certification under applicable programme components.
how_to_apply: Apply through an authorised PMKVY training centre or official programme channel.
official_source: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
short_description: Supports apprenticeship training and encourages employers to engage apprentices.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on apprenticeship and establishment requirements.
benefits: Apprenticeship training and financial support under applicable scheme provisions.
how_to_apply: Apply through the official apprenticeship system and participating establishments.
official_source: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
short_description: Provides skill development and placement-oriented training for eligible rural youth.
who_is_it_for: Eligible rural youth seeking skill training and employment
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable DDU-GKY requirements.
benefits: Skill training and employment-oriented support.
documents_required: Other documents required by the training programme
how_to_apply: Apply through an authorised DDU-GKY training centre or implementing agency.
